title: A session with no live lease of its own may not drive a booted phone.
ruling: Coordinator ruling, 2026-11-07 16:13 CST, from the owner's 2026-11-02 sim rulings (ruling 12 of decision sim-test-is-the-one-boot-path). Every session leases the shared phone before it uses it. A session with no live lease that drives a booted phone is refused, and the remedy names sim-lease take or sim-test --hold. Not on main; the PR adds guard rule simulator-drive-lease.
